theorem: Any exact intertwiner X between the prime logarithm generator diag(log p) and the quarter-shift oscillator diag(k+1/4) is zero.
proof_key: A nonzero matrix coefficient would require log(p)=k+1/4, contradicting Lindemann-Weierstrass.
interpretation: The logarithmic cutoff cancellation is an asymptotic density match, not an eigenmode duality.
required_coupling: A non-diagonal integral/incidence kernel with a nonzero commutator AX-XL_prime entering the completed Schur complement.
open_target: Evaluate oscillator or Mellin modes at log-prime positions and compare the resulting commutator defect with the Euler-region prime Green matrix element.
status: exact diagonal-intertwiner no-go; noncommuting relative transform open
